_comment: Famous UNESCO World Heritage sites, so the places people actually mean are typeable. Hand-picked, not the official list: that is 1,200-odd entries and somebody else's dataset, and bundling it would cross the line LICENSES.md draws. A name and a coordinate are facts, the same reasoning asterisms.json and darksky.json document. Coordinates are a representative point on the site, not a boundary. Timezones are IANA names so the clock is right. Nothing here claims anything about the sky: several of these sit in the middle of lit cities and the pages will say so, computed from the light-pollution model like anywhere else.
